title: Global Regulatory & Statutory Open Metadata Index (2024–2026) — 38,856 Official Dossiers Across 37 Jurisdictions
description:
Automated, machine-readable bibliographic metadata catalog (CSV, JSONL, Frictionless Data Package, and complete per-jurisdiction Markdown directories) indexing 38,856 official primary and secondary laws, final and proposed rules, statutory instruments, central bank circulars, supreme audit reports, and multilateral resolutions across 831 government departments, ministries, regulatory agencies, and multilateral organs in 37 active jurisdictions: United States (15,227 dossiers | Catalog), United Kingdom (2,572 dossiers | Catalog), Canada (5,372 dossiers | Catalog), European Union (4,005 dossiers | Catalog), United Nations (6,954 dossiers | Catalog), Ireland (178 dossiers | Catalog), Australia (1,267 dossiers | Catalog), International (952 dossiers | Catalog), Austria (164 dossiers | Catalog), Switzerland (189 dossiers | Catalog), Finland (66 dossiers | Catalog), France (402 dossiers | Catalog), South Korea (66 dossiers | Catalog), Norway (71 dossiers | Catalog), Italy (71 dossiers | Catalog), Philippines (322 dossiers | Catalog), Poland (43 dossiers | Catalog), South Africa (46 dossiers | Catalog), India (15 dossiers | Catalog), Belgium (25 dossiers | Catalog), Brazil (84 dossiers | Catalog), Japan (88 dossiers | Catalog), Netherlands (32 dossiers | Catalog), Russia (34 dossiers | Catalog), Sweden (47 dossiers | Catalog), China (27 dossiers | Catalog), Czechia (36 dossiers | Catalog), Germany (149 dossiers | Catalog), Denmark (39 dossiers | Catalog), Estonia (16 dossiers | Catalog), Spain (38 dossiers | Catalog), Israel (139 dossiers | Catalog), Iceland (14 dossiers | Catalog), Lithuania (0 dossiers | Catalog), Portugal (23 dossiers | Catalog), Singapore (82 dossiers | Catalog), Ukraine (1 dossiers | Catalog).

Full plain-English executive briefings, structured HTML compliance matrices, semantic definition lists, two-stage Tables of Contents, authority RSS syndication feeds, and unabridged source PDF dossiers are accessible via each record's canonical URL on https://www.indexdata.org, the Complete Issuing Authority Directory, the AI/LLM manifests (llms.txt and llms-full.txt), and Wikidata entity Q142071440.
